info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Wholesale Trading Program Tradings-spec
info.description: This API provides access to the details of wholesale trading programs, enabling users to retrieve information on specific trading activities within these programs. Aimed at financial institutions and traders, it allows for the effective monitoring and evaluation of trading programs' performance. Users can explore various attributes, including trading types and associated metrics, aiding in strategic decision-making. This API is essential for stakeholders involved in wholesale trading who need to analyze and optimize their trading strategies.

get.description: Fetch the latest information regarding program trading within the wholesale trading domain. This endpoint provides essential trading metrics and details to help users make informed decisions.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving program trading information within wholesale trading. This should include all necessary parameters structured according to the defined schema.

200.description: The request was successful, and the response contains the requested data.
